APC.liftingRepetitions: Defines lifting repetitions for joint randomized lifting output and witness membership.
APC.liftingSampleCount_valid: Lifting sample count valid. Joint randomized lifting output and witness membership.
APC.liftingRepetitions_bound: Lifting repetitions bound. Joint randomized lifting output and witness membership.

APC.logLevel: Defines log level for least log stopping index and uniform error budget.

APC.terminal_geometric_sum: At most one terminal transition need fail the geometric contraction.

APC.logStageError_nonneg: Nonnegativity of log stage error. Least log stopping index and uniform error budget.

APC.MetricIteration.supportSearch: Exhaustive summary-only search. Ordered tuples allow repeated centers; no center outside the summary is inspected by this final search.
APC.MetricIteration.supportCenters: Defines support centers for final support search, returned solution correctness and candidate counts.
APC.MetricIteration.supportSearch_spec: Correctness specification for support search. Final support search, returned solution correctness and candidate counts.
APC.MetricIteration.supportCenters_suppo: Support guarantee for support centers. Final support search, returned solution correctness and candidate counts.

APC.MetricIteration.terminal_enumeration: An explicit input-size-independent bound on the number of ordered candidate tuples examined by the final solver. This is not a full runtime bound nor the sharper binomial enumeration bound in the paper.
APC.geometricStageFailure: A fully specified summable failure schedule for the recursive-count implementation. It deliberately differs from Algorithm 4's size-based schedule, whose sample-size domination remains separate.
APC.geometricStageFailure_pos: Positivity of geometric stage failure. Full log stopping and recursive-count output guarantee.
APC.geometricStageFailure_sum: Normalization or sum identity for geometric stage failure. Full log stopping and recursive-count output guarantee.
APC.geometricStageFailure_budget: Geometric stage failure budget. Full log stopping and recursive-count output guarantee.
APC.logStageError_pos: Positivity of log stage error. Full log stopping and recursive-count output guarantee.
APC.logStageError_le_one: Log stage error le one. Full log stopping and recursive-count output guarantee.
APC.MetricIteration.log_schedule_compres: A complete finite random experiment for iterated metric compression: use the verified exact recursive sample counts, stop at the first clamped iterated logarithm, and round each supplied solution to the final support. The probability that any supplied α-solution lacks a (4+ε)α lift is ≤1/2. The near-linear, input-size-independent bound for these recursive counts is not asserted by this theorem.
